elena.product: Hey everyone — rolling out Hosted Tool Bridge (HTB) to GA starting now :tada:

elena.product: HTB is a single hosted endpoint (/v3/bridge) that unifies streaming generation + tool-calling orchestration. It provides:
- streaming tokens (chunked frames)
- structured tool invocation with automatic retries/fallbacks
- per-request routing policy (latency vs cost)

marcus.eng: Quick Q — is this a new model bundle or just an endpoint-layer feature? Any changes to runtime or kernels?

elena.product: It's primarily an endpoint-level product. We reuse existing verified model bundles (mosaicx-lite family) but enable orchestration middleware that coordinates tool processes and streaming frames. Runtime changes are in the bridge agent (no kernel changes), deployed to hosted pools today.

priya.docs: Docs and migration guide are live: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/483 — includes Python/Node examples and dropout-safe retries. I'll add a short FAQ for common tool patterns.

elena.product: Rollout plan: staged GA by account tier
- 0-6h: internal opt-in (team preview)
- 6-48h: gradual rollout to hosted free & paid accounts (10% -> 50%)
- 48-168h: ramp to 100% with monitoring gates
There will be a migration window for the old /v2/tool-run endpoint (see below).

daniel.sre: Noted — we'll run a canary through the realtime clusters and monitor p95 latency and error-rate. I've scheduled a maintenance window (non-disruptive) if we need fast rollback: Sat 03/28 03:00 UTC.

elena.product: Backwards compatibility: existing SDK calls to /v2/tool-run will continue to work for 90 days. We strongly recommend migrating to /v3/bridge for improved streaming + tool consistency. Deprecation timeline:
- 90 days: deprecation announcement
- 120 days: traffic redirect (read-only)
- 150 days: endpoint sunset

priya.docs: Migration snippet (Python):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.bridge.generate_stream(
  model="mosaicx-lite-1.1",
  prompt="Analyze this and call my_tool when needed",
  tools=[{"name":"my_tool","url":"https://svc.internal/my_tool"}],
)
for chunk in resp:
  print(chunk.text, end='')
```

elena.product: Quick curl sample for the new endpoint (streaming):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v3/bridge \n  -d '{"model":"mosaicx-lite-1.1","prompt":"Summarize and call tools","tools":[{"name":"lookup","spec":{}}],"stream":true}'
```

amy-support: Heads-up for support teams — prepared an internal KB and canned responses for customer migration questions. Link: https://redwood.internal/kb/htb-migration

jenkins-bot: deploy status: bridge-agent v1.0.0 deployed to hosted pools at 1948768200 — all health checks passed.

marcus.eng: Any expected client SDK changes? Will keep an eye on memory/KV usage in long-lived streams.

priya.docs: SDKs will get a v3 method (bridge.generate_stream / bridge.create) — we've added typed responses and structured tool events. The PRs include changelogs and snippets.
